decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 7/10/05, the erection of a rear dormer roof extension measuring 2.5m high, 6.0m wide and 3.1m deep and the conversion of existing rear store to study/office increasing in height by 500mm were lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Classes A and B of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
Condition : 2 - Informatives:
1		The detached study/office hereby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse known as 11 Redlees Close and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a rear dormer window with loft conversion to house to form habitable room and conversion of existing rear store to study.
